## Introduction

The safety of municipal water supplies relies heavily on regular monitoring and accurate reporting of water quality test results. When tests reveal contaminants exceeding permissible levels—often referred to as action levels—transparent and timely reporting is critical for protecting public health. This document provides a detailed guide to ensure accurate reporting of failed municipal water quality tests. It takes into consideration the steps from initial data collection to the final reporting process.
